chunks: From him, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Aban, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked: A man caught a fish, and inside its belly was another fish. He said: 'Both are to be eaten.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat fish that contains another fish inside its belly?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the permissibility of consuming nested fish, affirming that the inner fish is halal without requiring separate slaughter. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that fish caught from the sea are inherently pure and edible, resolving practical questions about food sources in maritime contexts.
